map.基于ACR TI-RADS(2017)标准，根据超声特征评分进行甲状腺结节风险分: Using the ACR TI-RADS (2017) criteria, score the ultrasound features to stratify thyroid nodule risk and give management advice
map.📖 查看「甲状腺结节(TI-RADS)分层器 使用指南」: 📖 See the "Thyroid Nodule (TI-RADS) Stratifier User Guide"
map.ACR TI-RADS（2017）按五项累计评分：成分（囊性 0、混合 1、实性: ACR TI-RADS (2017) scores five features and adds them up: composition (cystic 0, mixed 1, solid 2) + echogenicity (anechoic 0, hyperechoic or isoechoic 1, hypoechoic 2, very hypoechoic 3) + shape (wider than tall 0, taller than wide 3) + margins (smooth 0, ill-defined 1, lobulated or irregular 2, extrathyroidal extension 3) + echogenic foci (none or large comet-tail 0, coarse calcification 1, peripheral rim calcification 2, punctate echogenic foci 3); a total of 0 is TR1, 2 is TR2, 3 is TR3, 4 to 6 is TR4, and 7 or more is TR5; fine-needle aspiration is advised for TR4 at 1.5cm or larger or TR5 at 1cm or larger, and TR3 and above should be followed up.
map.ACR TI-RADS 评分与管理标准: ACR TI-RADS scoring and management standard
map.TI-RADS为风险评估系统，不能替代病理诊断。FNA（细针穿刺活检）是确诊金标: TI-RADS is a risk assessment system and does not replace pathological diagnosis. FNA (fine-needle aspiration biopsy) is the confirmatory gold standard. The follow-up interval is usually 6-12 months, shortened to 3-6 months for high-risk nodules.

map.成分 2 分 + 回声 2 分 + 形态 3 分（纵横比>1）+ 边缘 2 分: Composition 2 + echogenicity 2 + shape 3 (taller than wide) + margins 2 + echogenic foci 2 gives 11 points → TR 5 (highly suspicious). FNA is advised for a nodule of 1.5 cm or more.
map.ACR TI-RADS 与其他版本？: How does ACR TI-RADS compare with other versions?
map.ACR 采用 5 项加分法，ATA/MACIS 各有侧重；本工具按 ACR 评分: ACR uses a five-feature additive score while ATA and MACIS each have their own emphasis; this tool scores by ACR, and clinically you should follow whichever standard your hospital uses.
map.分值对应的处理？: What does each score mean for management?
map.TR 3 多随访、TR 4 视大小（≥1.5 cm）穿刺、TR 5 较小组（≥1: TR 3 mostly needs follow-up, TR 4 is aspirated depending on size (≥1.5 cm) and TR 5 is aspirated even when small (≥1 cm); very low-risk nodules (purely cystic or spongiform) can be followed up alone.
